skills.name: Common-denominator fraction subtraction
skills.definition: Subtract fractions that already have a common denominator by subtracting numerators, including proper and improper fractions.

skills.name: Unlike-denominator conversion
skills.definition: Rewrite fractions with unlike denominators as equivalent fractions with a common denominator before subtracting.

skills.name: Mixed and whole number representation
skills.definition: Interpret, convert, or decompose whole numbers, mixed numbers, and improper fractions for subtraction.

skills.name: Regrouping or borrowing
skills.definition: Rename a whole or mixed number by borrowing from the whole-number part when the fractional part of the minuend is too small.
